metadata.name: Decision Mirror Organic Decision Gold Dataset
metadata.transcription_note: Decision text and annotation wording transcribed from the source PDF. Dashed values remain null; no values were inferred.

records.decision_text: I rejected a startup position because I couldn't risk losing my current income.
gold_evidence: I couldn't risk losing my current income.

gold_situational_factor.description: Current financial dependency (explicitly stated) -- dampens confidence that this reflects a stable trait rather than a constraint.

records.decision_text: I took the international assignment even though my partner didn't want to move, because it was the right step for my career.
gold_evidence: "It was the right step for my career," chosen despite partner's preference.

records.decision_text: I spent three weeks comparing every laptop on the market with a spreadsheet before buying one.
gold_evidence: "Three weeks comparing every laptop... with a spreadsheet."

records.decision_text: I wanted to take the risky opportunity, but my family convinced me not to, so I stayed in my current job.
gold_evidence: "I wanted to take the risky opportunity" indicates underlying preference, but the final choice was overridden by family influence.

gold_situational_factor.description: Family pressure explicitly named as the deciding factor, not the person's own risk stance.

records.ambiguity_note: The ontology gives Risk Tolerance as -- with confidence 0.35. Its note says to record the stated preference at reduced confidence, while also saying not to score the trait from the final action; the numeric value is intentionally left null.

records.decision_text: I chose the cheaper university because I couldn't afford the other one.

gold_situational_factor.description: Pure financial constraint -- no value-based reasoning is present at all.

records.ambiguity_note: The ontology assigns -- to Risk Tolerance and Time Horizon despite confidence 0.20 for each; the scores remain null.

records.decision_text: I chose option A.
I quit my stable corporate job to freelance full-time, even though income will be unpredictable for at least a year.
gold_evidence: "Even though income will be unpredictable for at least a year" -- explicit acceptance of near-term instability for a longer-term goal.

records.decision_text: I stayed an extra year at my job I disliked so I could vest my stock options before leaving.
gold_evidence: Endured dissatisfaction for a specific deferred financial benefit.

records.decision_text: I said yes to the blind date because my friend really wanted me to meet him, even though I wasn't in the mood to go out.
gold_evidence: Went despite personal reluctance, to satisfy a friend's wish.

gold_situational_factor.description: Low-stakes social decision -- evidence is present but the decision's overall significance is minor, which should be reflected in lower weight during profile aggregation even though confidence in the extraction itself is moderate.

records.decision_text: Six months ago I would never have negotiated my salary, but this time I pushed back and asked for 15% more.
gold_evidence: Explicit self-reported contrast with past behavior.
records.ambiguity_note: The ontology labels the decision an ambiguous edge case and describes it as Self-Consistency-relevant, but assigns no T06 value.

records.decision_text: I turned down a higher-paying job in another city to stay near my aging parents.
gold_evidence: Explicit prioritization of family proximity over a better financial offer.

gold_situational_factor.description: Caregiving context noted but framed as a value, not merely a constraint -- raises confidence that this reflects a stable priority.

records.decision_text: I picked the restaurant everyone else wanted even though I don't love that cuisine.
gold_evidence: Deferred to group preference over personal preference.

gold_situational_factor.description: Extremely low-stakes decision; should contribute minimally to the running profile despite a clear directional signal.

records.decision_text: I signed the lease within an hour of seeing the apartment because I just had a good feeling about it.
gold_evidence: "Within an hour" and "just had a good feeling."

records.decision_text: I've turned down three promotions in a row because each one would have meant more travel and less time with my kids.
gold_evidence: Repeated pattern across three separate decisions with the same stated reasoning.

records.decision_text: I went with the loan offer with the lower monthly payment, without really comparing the total interest over the life of the loan.
gold_evidence: Optimized for near-term cash flow without evaluating longer-term total cost.

gold_situational_factor.description: Possible financial pressure implied but not stated -- confidence kept moderate rather than high.

records.ambiguity_note: The ontology explicitly says it is unclear whether the shorter time horizon was a preference or a necessity such as limited monthly cash, and flags it for clarification.

records.decision_text: I've been offered the same kind of 'safe but boring' role three times in five years and rejected all three for something less certain but more interesting.
gold_evidence: Repeated, directionally consistent choices across multiple independent decisions.

records.decision_text: I stayed in an unhappy relationship for two years because I was scared of being alone, even though I knew logically it wasn't working.
gold_evidence: Explicit statement that fear overrode acknowledged logical conclusion.

records.decision_text: Over the last two years my decisions have shifted from consistently risk-averse to consistently more willing to take chances, coinciding with a promotion and higher savings.
gold_evidence: Explicit longitudinal self-report of change, with a plausible situational driver (financial security) named.

gold_situational_factor.description: Increased financial cushion given as the likely cause -- this should be modeled as a genuine profile shift, not as inconsistency to be penalized.

records.ambiguity_note: The ontology labels it an ambiguous edge case and describes a real situationally driven profile shift; interpretation of T06 should not turn this change into a penalty.

records.decision_text: I keep saying I want to prioritize my health, but every time work gets busy I skip the gym and work late instead.
gold_evidence: Explicit gap between stated value and repeated behavior.

gold_situational_factor.description: Recurring situational pressure (work busyness) is the repeated trigger -- itself a pattern worth surfacing to the user descriptively.

records.ambiguity_note: The ontology labels the decision an ambiguous edge case and requires a descriptive account of the context-dependent gap, not a judgmental label.

records.decision_text: I moved back in with my parents for a year to save aggressively before buying a home, even though it meant giving up my independence and a shorter commute.
gold_evidence: Explicit near-term sacrifice (independence, commute) for a stated longer-term financial goal.
